fields.name: PgConnectionPropertiesBase PostgreSQL connection-property surface
fields.contract: PgConnectionPropertiesBase is an abstract, mutable PostgreSQL connection-property surface. A derived configuration can independently leave each declared setting unspecified or provide a value for connection identity, authentication and certificate selection, pooling and connection lifetime, command and cancellation timeouts, session and protocol controls, socket and transport controls, and preparation or multiplexing controls.
